scene: The salvaged compass spins wildly, pointing past three bustling transport departures.
picture: Side-scrolling wide view of Lighthouse Reef's rocky terminal. On the far left, a hillside chairlift platform hangs beside cliffside cables. Left of centre stands the boy, clutching a dripping brass compass. In the centre, an ornate sleigh tram sits on frosty rails. On the far right, a tethered hot-air balloon bobs gently.
shown: a dangling two-seater chairlift swing idling at its wooden dock on the far left
a brass sleigh-shaped tram waiting on frosted rails near the centre
a striped hot-air balloon with a wicker basket tethered on the far right
